missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Противник' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Сильный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'очень' intensifies the assessment.

Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate noun. 'Противника' takes the genitive-shaped accusative because 'противник' is animate masculine, as the object of 'победила'. 'Опасного' agrees in the same form.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Противника' takes the genitive after 'нет', stating that no serious opponent exists. 'Серьёзного' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after the verb. 'Противнику' is in the dative because 'проиграть' governs the dative for whom one loses to. 'Этому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Противником' is in the instrumental after 'с', marking the opponent of the meeting. 'Новым' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Противнике' takes the prepositional form after 'о', the topic of our knowledge. 'Много' adds the extent.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Противники' is the nominative plural subject. 'Наши' agrees in the plural, and 'готовы' is the short-form predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Противников' takes the genitive plural after 'планы', expressing whose plans they are. 'Изучил' names the completed study.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural of an animate noun. 'Противников' takes the genitive-shaped accusative plural because opponents are animate, as the object of 'разбила'. 'Всех' agrees in the same form.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Противник' is the nominative subject of 'отступил'. 'Без боя' uses the genitive to describe a retreat without a fight.
